parameters.name: AddressGroups
parameters.description: The application address groups. This parameter can be specified when ConfigMode is set to Precise. This parameter cannot be specified when ConfigMode is an empty string.

parameters.name: Addresses
parameters.description: The addresses of the private access application. You can specify up to 1000 addresses.

parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description:
The ID of the private access application. You can obtain the value from:
- [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~): Lists private access applications.
- [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~): Creates a private access application.

parameters.name: ConfigMode
parameters.description:
The configuration mode. Valid values:
* Empty string: default mode.
* Precise: precise mode.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the private access application. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

parameters.name: L7Config
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter: the Layer 7 application configuration.

parameters.name: L7ProxyDomainAutomaticPrefix
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter: the prefix of the mapped proxy domain name. The prefix must be 3 to 20 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: L7ProxyDomainCustom
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter: the custom proxy domain name.

parameters.name: L7ProxyDomainPrivate
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter: the private proxy domain name.

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description:
The modification type of the private access application. Valid values:
- **Cover** (default): overwrites the original addresses, port ranges, and tag IDs with the values of the **Addresses**, **PortRanges**, and **TagIds** parameters.
- **Append**: appends the values of the **Addresses**, **PortRanges**, and **TagIds** parameters to the original addresses, port ranges, and tag IDs.

parameters.name: PortRanges
parameters.description: The port ranges of the private access application. You can specify up to 65535 port ranges. Multiple port ranges cannot overlap.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol of the private access application. Valid values:
- **All**: all protocols.
- **TCP**
- **UDP**

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the private access application. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: enabled.
- **Disabled**: disabled.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The IDs of private access tags. A private access application can be associated with up to 6 custom private access tags.

parameters.name: UnauthorizedAccessConfig
parameters.description: The configuration for unauthorized application access requests.
